note: Recent work is listed first. Earlier dates cover selected milestones reconstructed from saved reports and project notes; they are not a complete activity history.

items.text: Consolidated Reports to two main entries and the compiler report from eight views to five. Current results/examples stay prominent; older comparisons share History and all old URLs remain valid.
items.label: History and earlier reports

items.text: Clarified the remaining449 claims:29 tested rewrite failures and420 untested. First checks group227 predicate-formation,173 content omission,43 operator/type and6 explicit alignment/context failures. No new model/compiler run.
items.label: Why the remaining claims fail

items.text: Separated sentence generation from original-mention alignment and repeated both31-case conditions. Each condition gives2 reviewed faithful recoveries; the sentences-only condition recovers Trump/image and police officers. No per-claim prompt union.
items.label: Alignment comparison and limits

items.text: Freshly recompiled all2,375 originals with exact saved-record equality:1,924 passes (81.01%) and2,103 candidates (88.55%). Two reviewed automatic splits give1,926 passes (81.09%);449 failures remain.
items.label: Current full-corpus pass rate

items.text: Published all62 case comparisons with inferred mention links, exact prompts/raw responses, compiled structures and failure reasons. Shorter text still fails on quantity, source scope, references and negation.
items.label: Inspect automatic examples

items.text: Tested sentence splitting on31 failed originals with one frozen Qwen prompt:65/77 clauses pass,20 cases have all components pass, but0 complete automatic results are approved as faithful. Passing originals bypass generation.
items.label: Sentence splitting experiment

items.text: Added8 assistant-written controlled cases, explicitly separate from model output:7 splits give18/18 passing clauses and4 faithful linked compositions; one no-audio guard stays refused. Image context matters; quantity and tagging errors remain.
items.label: Inspect clean and automatic versions

items.text: Kept the38 direct-compiler files unchanged. Added a separate tested composition adapter and retained initial/final sources, exact prompts, responses and failure explanations. Original corpus counts remain2,103 generated/1,924 passing; no new media or training.
items.label: Implementation and limits

items.text: Enforced direct compilation before model loading:31 historical failures eligible,9 direct passes skipped. A separate all-passing input exits with zero model requests. No new generation or compiler change.
items.label: Failure-only routing

items.text: Added five failed examples and exact saved prompts, raw responses, model settings and rejection reasons for both historical conditions. Passing diagnostic probes are explicitly outside the fallback path.
items.label: Failures, prompts and model

items.text: Completed two frozen-model rewrite conditions on the same40 cases. Assistant-reviewed faithful target recoveries1/24 then2/24, plus one revised exact-quote guard. Both conditions fail the proposed gates.
items.label: Both prompts and all40 comparisons

items.text: Recompiled all2,375 original claims with exact saved-record equality, then reran all2,375 with only three reviewed replacements:2,105 generated and1,927 passing content checks. No automatic corpus-wide rewrite or new relation training.
items.label: Decision, counts and remaining problems

items.text: Separated program generation from content-check counts across four saved runs. All 2,099 original candidates remain; current counts stay 2,103 generated and 1,924 passing.
items.label: Comparable metric definitions

items.text: Reviewed all 179 candidate alerts: 166 apparent gaps, five likely overstrict word alerts and eight context-dependent cases. No compiler status was changed.
items.label: Alert review

items.text: Reviewed 34 stratified refusals, 23 passing controls and 22 targeted clause-literal cases. Passing outputs can still miss event bindings and source scope.
items.label: Cases and limits

items.text: Recommended freezing broad grammar expansion and developing a small checked rewrite pilot next. No rewrite, model call, training or new inference experiment was run.
items.label: Stopping decision and pilot proposal

items.text: Completed the next two compiler steps: identifiers, quantities and appositions, followed by explicit lists and selected embedded clauses. Reran all 2,375 claims: 1,924 pass checks, 58 more than before, with no earlier pass lost.

items.text: Recovered the two leader lists and two hidden clauses. Six difficult clause cases remain explicit refusals with reasons.
